description: Hydrophobic-matching test: TM helix length and hydrophobicity of AIG1/ADTRP against human polytopic ER-membrane and plasma-membrane reference sets
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

KD = dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
          M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
hp=pd.read_csv("out/human_reviewed.tsv",sep="\t").dropna(subset=["Sequence","Transmembrane"]).copy()
hp["Sequence"]=hp["Sequence"].astype(str); hp["Transmembrane"]=hp["Transmembrane"].astype(str)
go=hp["Gene Ontology (cellular component)"].fillna("")
hp["ER_mem"]=go.str.contains("GO:0005789"); hp["PM"]=go.str.contains("GO:0005886")
rng=re.compile(r"TRANSMEM (\d+)\.\.(\d+)")

def tm_stats(row):
    out=[]
    for a,b in rng.findall(row.Transmembrane):
        a,b=int(a),int(b); h=row.Sequence[a-1:b]
        if len(h)<10: continue
        out.append((len(h), np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in h])))
    return out

recs=[]
for _,r in hp.iterrows():
    st=tm_stats(r)
    if len(st)<6: continue                      # polytopic, matched to AIG1's architecture
    L=np.mean([x[0] for x in st]); H=np.mean([x[1] for x in st])
    recs.append(dict(gene=r["Gene Names (primary)"], acc=r.Entry, ntm=len(st),
                     mean_tm_len=L, mean_tm_kd=H, ER=r.ER_mem, PM=r.PM))
d=pd.DataFrame(recs)
# clean comparison sets: exclusively ER or exclusively PM annotated
er=d[d.ER & ~d.PM]; pm=d[d.PM & ~d.ER]
print(f"Human polytopic proteins with >=6 annotated TM helices: n={len(d)}")
print(f"  ER-membrane only : n={len(er)}")
print(f"  plasma-membrane only: n={len(pm)}")
for col,lab in [("mean_tm_len","mean TM helix length (aa)"),("mean_tm_kd","mean TM Kyte-Doolittle")]:
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(er[col],pm[col])
    # rank-biserial effect size
    rbc=1-2*u/(len(er)*len(pm))
    print(f"\n{lab}:")
    print(f"   ER  median {er[col].median():.2f}  IQR {er[col].quantile(.25):.2f}-{er[col].quantile(.75):.2f}")
    print(f"   PM  median {pm[col].median():.2f}  IQR {pm[col].quantile(.25):.2f}-{pm[col].quantile(.75):.2f}")
    print(f"   Mann-Whitney p={p:.3g}, rank-biserial r={rbc:+.2f}")

AIG1={"acc":"Q9NVV5"}; ADTRP={"acc":"Q96IZ2"}
for nm,acc in [("AIG1","Q9NVV5"),("ADTRP","Q96IZ2")]:
    row=hp[hp.Entry==acc].iloc[0]; st=tm_stats(row)
    L=np.mean([x[0] for x in st]); H=np.mean([x[1] for x in st])
    pL_er=100*(er.mean_tm_len<L).mean(); pL_pm=100*(pm.mean_tm_len<L).mean()
    pH_er=100*(er.mean_tm_kd<H).mean();  pH_pm=100*(pm.mean_tm_kd<H).mean()
    print(f"\n{nm}: {len(st)} TM, mean length {L:.1f} aa, mean KD {H:+.3f}")
    print(f"   length  percentile within ER set {pL_er:.0f}, within PM set {pL_pm:.0f}")
    print(f"   KD      percentile within ER set {pH_er:.0f}, within PM set {pH_pm:.0f}")
    print(f"   per-helix KD: {[f'{x[1]:+.2f}' for x in st]}")
    globals()[nm]=dict(L=L,H=H)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.8))
for ax,col,lab,lo,hi in [(axes[0],"mean_tm_len","mean TM helix length (aa)",15,30),
                         (axes[1],"mean_tm_kd","mean TM Kyte-Doolittle hydrophobicity",-0.5,2.6)]:
    bins=np.linspace(lo,hi,34)
    ax.hist(er[col],bins=bins,alpha=.6,color="#2b6cb0",density=True,label=f"ER membrane only (n={len(er)})")
    ax.hist(pm[col],bins=bins,alpha=.6,color="#c05621",density=True,label=f"plasma membrane only (n={len(pm)})")
    for nm,c in [("AIG1","#000000"),("ADTRP","#6b46c1")]:
        v=globals()[nm]["L" if col=="mean_tm_len" else "H"]
        ax.axvline(v,color=c,lw=2.2,ls="--")
        ax.text(v,ax.get_ylim()[1]*.92,f" {nm}",color=c,fontsize=10,weight="bold")
    ax.set_xlabel(lab); ax.set_ylabel("density"); ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_title("TM helix length, human proteins with ≥6 TM helices")
axes[1].set_title("TM helix hydrophobicity, same proteins")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
d.to_csv("out/polytopic_tm_length_hydrophobicity.csv",index=False)
